look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Opposite SIMPLE leaves with one blade deeply palmately divided into usually 5–7 pointed, finely toothed lobes; verify opposite buds and paired winged samaras. Cultivars vary widely in leaf shape and color; red foliage alone is not diagnostic.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Deciduous small ornamental tree or shrub, highly variable by cultivar.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Opposite, simple, palmately 5–7(–9)-lobed serrate leaves with deep sinuses; no separate leaflets.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Small inconspicuous spring flowers; use opposite foliage and fruit for confirmation.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Paired winged samaras attached at the seed ends.

key_traits.label: Stem bud
key_traits.text: Opposite twigs and buds; often smooth bark on young shoots.
